localChanges: chore: pick up core-city 0.1.14 and core-registry 0.1.5

log: `expect(city.tilesWorked()).to.include(tile)` only passed against an old core-world. Chai's `include` does not look inside an `EntityRegistry`, so against the current core-world 0.1.18 / core-registry 0.1.4 it checks property subsets instead and fails: "expected Tileset{ …(3) } to have property '_keys'". That was the red CI run (civ-clone/web-renderer#66).
Node 12 and actions v1 no longer install this project's dependencies (civ-clone/web-renderer#66). CI installs with pnpm as web-renderer does.
prettier:check had no --check, so it printed the formatted source and passed whatever it found.
The 0.1.4 build left `.js`/`.d.ts` in tsc's own formatting, so CI's `prettier:check` failed (civ-clone/web-renderer#66). Whitespace only.
Node 12 and actions v1 no longer install this project's dependencies (civ-clone/web-renderer#66). pnpm-lock.yaml is ignored by prettier:check, since CI's own install writes it.
Formatting first and compiling second left tsc's unformatted output behind, which is how 0.1.4 shipped files that failed prettier:check (civ-clone/web-renderer#66).
